Scope: Catalog-driven package prerequisite expansion, removal ordering, mutation guard, offline package coverage and lifecycle regression
VerifiedBehavior: Declared prerequisites expand before consumers with a reason and deduplicate with explicit profile selections.
Unsatisfied registered prerequisites fail closed; dependent packages uninstall before prerequisites, and installed dependents block prerequisite removal.
A hand-built consumer-only mutation plan is rejected before snapshot creation or handler dispatch.

Offline profile coverage and execution preflight accept explicitly selected catalog prerequisite artifacts when ordered before consumers; artifact-level dependency installer actions remain unsupported.
Unsupported prerequisite candidates are allowed only when an already-installed package satisfies the declared state; pending candidates remain unavailable for new installation.
